dynamic_adapters.source: Copies a deployment wait code that prepare_failure already resolved through the failure contract (or the registered live_route_unavailable) onto the live-status watch receipt, so the stuck-founder alert and staff console can name why the founder's live site has not updated after 24 hours; never founder-facing authority and never a stop.
